column2: Ii-odolo zokutya, ikhithini neencwadi. Simahla ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.
Isimo sanamhlanje. Iodolo = ii-odolo ezingenayo. Thenga = okuthengiweyo neendleko. Amaqela = abathengi bekhredithi nababoneleli.
Amaxwebhu eenkcitho nee-akhawunti zababoneleli (imali ephumayo). Okwis-akhawunti kuhlala kwincwadi yeqela.

Inombolo yeqela yodwa (amagama anokuphinda). Umthengi unencwadi yekhredithi (usityala); Umboneleli usithengisa isitokhwe (simtyala); bobabini kulungile. Iincwadi zihlala zihlukene; iingxelo zibonisa isixa.
Incwadi yosuku, abanamatyala nabanikwe, incwadi yebhanki, amaxwebhu eenkcitho, inzuzo nelahleko.

Cofa into ukuze uyihlengahlengise. Into entsha icima ifom. Khangela ukutya kwethu okanye uchwetheze igama lakho nefoto, misa ixabiso (0 kulungile), emva koko Yongeza. Intengiso esele ibhaliwe igcina igama elahlawulwa ngalo.
Buyisela ibuyisela into kuluhlu njengoko yayinjalo — ixabiso, ifoto kunye nodidi. Ishelufa yethu yokutya ayisuswa, ngoko ukutya kunokongezwa kwakhona.

Xa icinyiwe, idesika yee-odolo ifihla imigca yoqikelelo lwe-GST/irhafu kunye neendawo ze-GST-kwixabiso. Amazinga erhafu kunye nezicwangciso zeLizwe nerhafu ziyahlala — vula iileyibhile kwakhona nanini na. Ezinye iitemplate zevenkile ziqala kucinyiwe oku.

Xa icinyiwe, iibhili zingamanqaku emali kuphela kwaye amaqhosha i-Invoyisi yerhafu / Inqaku lemali afihliwe kwidesika yee-odolo. Ezinye iitemplate zevenkile ziqala kucinyiwe oku — vula u-Bonisa nanini na ukuze ukhethe kwakhona i-Invoyisi yerhafu.

Kwikhompyutha, cofa Qala nale khompyutha. Kwisi sixhobo ngasinye: faka i-app, khetha Imo yeKlayenti, Fumana iseva yevenkile (okanye chwetheza idilesi), faka ikhowudi yokudibanisa, Dibanisa ngoku. Ii-odolo zilinda kwisixhobo ukuba i-Wi‑Fi iyawa, zihambe xa iSeva iphendula kwakhona. Abashicileli bekhithini bamiswa kwiSeva (uSeto → Abashicileli) — ezinye iikhawuntara zithumela i-KOT apho.

Abashicileli bamiswa kwisixhobo sevenkile (Iseva). Le khawuntara ithumela amatyala nee-KOT apho — Fumana / yongeza / yabela kuhlala kwiSeva. Iphepha lovavanyo nobukhulu bokushicilela ityala ziya kwiSeva.
